fields.label: Ingress Nginx Enabled
fields.description: set to true only if ingress-nginx is NOT already in your cluster.

fields.label: Strimzi Kafka Operator Enabled
fields.description: set to true only if the Strimzi operator is NOT already installed. (see chart README).

fields.label: Kube Prometheus Stack Enabled
fields.description: needed only for AWES custom-metrics HPAs (kernel pool scaling). be non-functional (CPU/memory HPAs still work via metrics-server).

fields.label: Prometheus Adapter Enabled
fields.description: required alongside kube-prometheus-stack for custom-metrics HPAs. Must be installed after Prometheus is ready; configure its URL to match.

fields.label: Metrics Server Enabled
fields.description: but practically required: EKS and AKS do NOT ship metrics-server by default. Without it, CPU/memory-based HPAs will not work.

fields.label: Aws Efs Csi Driver Enabled
fields.description: AWS only. Enable if the EFS CSI driver is not already installed in kube-system. Leave disabled on Azure.

fields.label: Azurefile Csi Driver Enabled
fields.description: Azure only. AKS ships the Azure Files CSI driver by default; leave disabled unless you specifically need a newer version.

fields.description: default: "was". Change only if you need a different namespace name; note the application init-container readiness checks reference "was" by name.
